purpose: Document first-party Siwan cadastral discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: A first-party local/district cadastral custodian and public Bihar BhuNaksha viewer are evidenced. The live public viewer hierarchy and CRS/extent metadata were inspected, but no safe anonymous parcel identity plus full polygon response was verified.
registryAssessment: Local cadastral service evidenced: District Siwan Revenue Section links to Bihar land records, and the Bihar government BhuNaksha viewer exposes Siwan district map hierarchy. This is source evidence only, not runtime integration or source admission.
safeFieldAllowlist: safe public native parcel/source ID if available

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Siwan district page identifies Revenue Section land records and links to lrc.bih.nic.in.
Official Hindi Siwan district page gives the same revenue land-records route.
Official Bihar cadastral viewer. Current HTML identifies BhuNaksha Bihar as NIC cadastral mapping software and exposes the public map entry point.
Official DILRMP Siwan district page reports cadastral-map digitization/status metadata; it does not provide parcel geometry in the response used here.
